content:
I've finally written up a plan for the overhaul of LeanEval (with :bot: assistance; please expect to read LLM generated text here!)

https://github.com/kim-em/lean-eval/blob/8c7360335adbc60a942c8a2bad8498c499022c7a/PLAN.md

Please make comments either here on the Zulip or on the PR at leanprover/lean-eval#536. I'm hoping that I can get some feedback/criticism, and then start implementing, perhaps even by tomorrow.

Are there plans for lower-level "tags" (e.g., for the 50 annals problems, although I could imagine other useful tags such as for all the finite group theory problems)? If so, it would be nice if there was a way on the website to filter by tag to see how many of that tag have been solved.
Yes! Sorry, that had been on my list and I completely forgot to include it. I'll incorporate that now.
